fwd.name: Build the acrylic riser one leg at a time: riser screw, top plate, leg
fwd.instruction: Build the acrylic riser one leg at a time: stand a riser screw on its head, bring a corner hole of the top plate over the riser screw, and turn a leg onto the riser screw until the leg stops against the top plate; then turn the riser over onto its four legs.
fwd.steps:
1. Grab one riser screw in the Tool Zone (2), then place the riser screw upright on its ridged head in the Operation Zone (5); then grab the top plate in the Staging Zone (4) and move the top plate over the riser screw until the screw comes up through one corner hole; then grab one leg in the Supply Zone (1), put the leg on the tip of the riser screw and turn the leg clockwise, seen from above, until the leg stops against the top plate.
2. Grab a second riser screw in the Tool Zone (2), then place the riser screw upright on its ridged head in the Operation Zone (5) beside the top plate; then move the top plate over the riser screw until the screw comes up through the next corner hole; then put a second leg on the tip of the riser screw and turn the leg clockwise, seen from above, until the leg stops against the top plate.
3. Grab a third riser screw in the Tool Zone (2), then place the riser screw upright on its ridged head in the Operation Zone (5) beside the top plate; then move the top plate over the riser screw until the screw comes up through the next corner hole; then put a third leg on the tip of the riser screw and turn the leg clockwise, seen from above, until the leg stops against the top plate.
4. Grab the last riser screw in the Tool Zone (2), then place the riser screw upright on its ridged head in the Operation Zone (5) beside the top plate; then move the top plate over the riser screw until the screw comes up through the last corner hole; then put the last leg on the tip of the riser screw and turn the leg clockwise, seen from above, until the leg stops against the top plate.
5. Grab the top plate in the Operation Zone (5), then turn the riser over so it stands on its four legs, top plate up, and move it to the Finished Goods Zone (6) and place it upright on its four legs, curved edge toward the back of the mat.

rev.name: Reset: Acrylic Riser Assembly
rev.instruction: Take the acrylic riser apart one full leg at a time and return the legs to the Supply Zone (1), the riser screws to the Tool Zone (2) and the top plate to the Staging Zone (4).
rev.steps:
1. Grab the acrylic riser in the Finished Goods Zone (6), then move it to the Operation Zone (5) and turn it over, so it lies on its top plate with its four legs pointing up.
2. Turn one leg anticlockwise, seen from above, until the leg comes free of the riser screw, and place the leg flat on the mat in the Supply Zone (1); then take the riser screw out of its corner hole and place the riser screw flat on the mat in the Tool Zone (2).
3. Turn a second leg anticlockwise, seen from above, until the leg comes free of the riser screw, and place the leg flat in the Supply Zone (1), apart from the first leg; then take the riser screw out of its corner hole and place the riser screw flat in the Tool Zone (2), apart from the first riser screw.
4. Turn a third leg anticlockwise, seen from above, until the leg comes free of the riser screw, and place the leg flat in the Supply Zone (1), apart from the other legs; then take the riser screw out of its corner hole and place the riser screw flat in the Tool Zone (2), apart from the other riser screws.
5. Turn the last leg anticlockwise, seen from above, until the leg comes free, and place the leg flat in the Supply Zone (1), apart from the other legs; then take the last riser screw out and place the riser screw flat in the Tool Zone (2), apart from the other riser screws, and move the top plate to the Staging Zone (4) and place the top plate flat on the mat, curved edge toward the back of the mat.
